narrative.overview: SHUAMO exists to answer one question about money: where did this number come from? The interface is built as an instrument, not a dashboard. Every aggregate is a link to the rows beneath it, every forward-looking figure is labelled an estimate, and every amount is set in tabular mono so two numbers in a column can be compared by eye. Ink and paper carry the page. One electric signal marks the single thing to do next. Three state tones — accrued, settled, reversed — carry money's only three conditions, and they are always accompanied by words.

rules.name: The White-On-Signal Rule
rules.body: Text on `signal` is always `paper`. Ink on indigo fails contrast and is never used, including hover and active.

rules.name: The Money-Is-Mono Rule
rules.body: Every GEL amount — anywhere, at any size — is set in Geist Mono with `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`. Prose numbers are not money.

rules.name: The Provenance Rule
rules.body: Every aggregate figure links to the rows that produced it. A total the user cannot open is a total the user cannot check.

rules.name: The Estimate Rule
rules.body: A forward-looking number carries the word “estimate” in its visible label, in both locales. Catalogue price is display-only and the real commission always comes from the postback.

rules.name: The Single-Signal Rule
rules.body: One indigo element owns each decision surface. Two competing signals means one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The State-Needs-Words Rule
rules.body: Status is never colour alone. Every pill carries its label; a screenshot in greyscale must still be readable.

rules.name: The Equal-Script Rule
rules.body: Georgian may wrap earlier than English, but it is never given a smaller size, a lighter weight, or a truncation English does not get.

rules.name: The Dead-Link Rule
rules.body: The offer-ended page is a designed page, not an error page. A buyer who lands there was sent by a creator, and both of them deserve an explanation rather than a stack trace.

rules.name: The Exact-Offer Rule
rules.body: Product-offer surfaces show commission type and value exactly, keep every GEL figure in tabular mono, and label catalogue price and calculated creator earnings as estimates. Percent values may be entered for people as percentages, but their stored fraction remains visible to brands where a rate is authored or changed.

rules.name: The Terms-Before-Acceptance Rule
rules.body: A creator sees the full current affiliate terms, their version, and their effective date before explicitly accepting an offer. Once a tracking link exists, the decision control becomes a visible notice that the link preserves the accepted version; later edits never masquerade as the original agreement.
